language_layer.source_text_zh: 这个有保修吗？保修多久？
language_layer.raw_text_ms: Ada warranty ke? Warranty berapa lama?
language_layer.normalized_text_ms: Ada warranty ke? Warranty berapa lama?

language_layer.raw_text_ms: Barang rosak, bleh claim warranty tak?
language_layer.normalized_text_ms: Barang rosak, boleh claim warranty tak?

language_layer.raw_text_ms: Warranty period berapa? Ada 1 tahun ke?
language_layer.normalized_text_ms: Warranty period berapa? Ada 1 tahun ke?

language_layer.source_text_zh: 怎么申请保修？需要什么证明？
language_layer.raw_text_ms: Camne nak claim warranty? Perlukan apa bukti?
language_layer.normalized_text_ms: Macam mana nak claim warranty? Perlukan apa bukti?

language_layer.source_text_zh: 保修要钱吗？还是免费的？
language_layer.raw_text_ms: Warranty perlu bayar ke? Free ke?
language_layer.normalized_text_ms: Warranty perlukan bayar ke? Free ke?

language_layer.source_text_zh: 保修范围是什么？都包括吗？
产品坏了，要寄回去保修吗？
language_layer.raw_text_ms: Barang rosak, kena pos balik claim warranty?
language_layer.normalized_text_ms: Barang rosak, kena pos balik claim warranty?

language_layer.source_text_zh: 保修地址在哪里？我要寄回去。
language_layer.raw_text_ms: Warranty address kat mana? Sy nak pos balik.
language_layer.normalized_text_ms: Warranty address kat mana? Saya nak pos balik.

language_layer.raw_text_ms: Ada warranty card bila beli ke?
language_layer.normalized_text_ms: Ada warranty card bila beli ke?

language_layer.source_text_zh: 用了一个月坏了，可以保修吗？
language_layer.raw_text_ms: Guna sebulan dh rosak, bleh warranty ke?
language_layer.normalized_text_ms: Guna sebulan dah rosak, boleh warranty ke?

language_layer.source_text_zh: 保修期从什么时候开始算？
这个有保修卡吗？我找不到。
language_layer.raw_text_ms: Ada warranty card ke? Sy x jumpa.
language_layer.normalized_text_ms: Ada warranty card ke? Saya tak jumpa.

language_layer.source_text_zh: 我找不到保修卡，怎么办？
language_layer.raw_text_ms: Sy x jumpa warranty card, camne?
language_layer.normalized_text_ms: Saya tak jumpa warranty card, macam mana?

language_layer.source_text_zh: 保修期到了，还能保修吗？
language_layer.raw_text_ms: Warranty dh habis, masih boleh claim?
language_layer.normalized_text_ms: Warranty dah habis, masih boleh claim?

language_layer.source_text_zh: 需要提供保修卡的照片吗？

language_layer.raw_text_ms: Warranty perlukan proof of purchase ke?
language_layer.normalized_text_ms: Warranty perlukan proof of purchase ke?

language_layer.source_text_zh: 保修包括保修卡本身吗？
language_layer.raw_text_ms: Warranty termasuk warranty card sendiri ke?
language_layer.normalized_text_ms: Warranty termasuk warranty card sendiri ke?
